blocks.text: Dionela is set to become a father as he announced that his non-showbiz wife, Meizy Mendoza, is pregnant with their first child. The singer revealed Mendoza’s pregnancy through his Facebook page on Tuesday, Nov. 10, by flaunting her baby bump alongside two positive pregnancy kits. Dionela made the announcement a day prior to the release of his latest song, “Sarah,” which is in collaboration with John Roa. “Was about to release a new song tomorrow (11.11) with John Roa and prayed to God to bless and anoint it.
